calendar: Weekdays September 4–30 excluding September 7 Labor Day; regular 16:00 Eastern closes, no early closes in this interval; cross-check cached session grid
returns: Vendor-adjusted close_t / adjusted close_previous_session - 1; five-company basket mean of constituent simple returns, equal weights daily rebalanced; spread=basket minus SPY. Compound basket/SPY individually; compounded spread is a synthetic spread index, not the difference of cumulative returns or a self-financing portfolio.
alignment: (previous session close, current session close]; actual offset-aware original timestamps; weekends included; after September 30 close excluded
coverage: Every intersected Eastern date must have completed collection under its frozen source protocol. September 8 is unavailable because September 4–7 are uncollected. Completed bounded X days with 19/20 shortfalls remain observed with explicit shortfall flags; completed protocol is not exhaustive platform or intraday coverage. No observed channel records means missing mean, not zero.

secondary.name: sensitivity_combined_basket_2lag
secondary.conditional: Estimate only when unrestricted residual degrees of freedom are positive; restricted has two return lags, unrestricted also has two sentiment-change lags

change: sentiment_t - sentiment_(t-1), only on adjacent complete valid trading-session grid rows; never close gaps by dropping missing rows
tests: Manual least-squares restricted/unrestricted RSS F test; joint null all sentiment-change lag coefficients zero. Cross-check statsmodels OLS compare_f_test and f_test. Conventional unadjusted F p-values; no additional lags/models/baskets, no stationarity claim, no causal inference.
correlations: Pearson descriptive only: levels and changes of Guardian, X, combined and dedup-combined against basket and spread; same-session association and next-session association separately, no correlation p-values
data_caveats: Bounded X search sample; weak Codex-reviewed sentiment/framing validation; generic text sentiment in AI-related material, not validated AI attitudes; adjusted-price vendor conventions not independently rebuilt
freeze_timing: Saved before returns, correlations or regressions were calculated or viewed; existing sentiment scores were already available
